title: ‘Awards Chatter’ Pod: Guillermo del Toro on His 50-Year Journey to ‘Frankenstein’ and Being “Weird As F***”
summary: In front of an audience of film students at Chapman University, the three-time Oscar winner also reflected on his father's win of the Mexican lottery and subsequent kidnapping, coming up in the business as one of "the Three Amigos" and the "miracle" of Jacob Elordi.
